description: This file provides utility functions for resolving and expanding user home directories based on environment variables and system information, including handling of '~' prefix and environment-specific home directory paths.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a string value by trimming and converting 'null' or 'undefined' strings to undefined.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveHomeDir
methods.description: Resolves the effective home directory based on environment variables and system home directory, with fallback to undefined.

methods.name: resolveOsHomeDir
methods.description: Resolves the OS-specific home directory based on environment variables and system home directory, with fallback to undefined.

methods.name: resolveRawHomeDir
methods.description: Resolves raw home directory path considering explicit environment variable or fallback to OS home directory.

methods.name: resolveRawOsHomeDir
methods.description: Resolves raw OS home directory from environment variables or system home directory.

methods.name: normalizeSafe
methods.description: Safely normalizes the home directory obtained from the system, catching errors.

methods.name: resolveRequiredHomeDir
methods.description: Resolves the required home directory, defaulting to current working directory if not found.

methods.name: resolveRequiredOsHomeDir
methods.description: Resolves the required OS home directory, defaulting to current working directory if not found.

methods.name: expandHomePrefix
methods.description: Expands the '~' prefix in a path to the actual home directory, based on environment or system info.

methods.name: resolveHomeRelativePath
methods.description: Resolves a path relative to the home directory, expanding '~' if present.

methods.name: resolveOsHomeRelativePath
methods.description: Resolves a path relative to the OS-specific home directory, expanding '~' if present.
